name: signlocal-site
description: The signlocal website: static Astro pages in seven languages, built from the repository's own sources (release data, devices, SDK, examples) and published to GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: bun run data && astro build && bun scripts/preload-modules.ts && bun scripts/clean-dist.ts && sh ../sdk/tools/docs.sh --out dist/api
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run verify
